a.lede: Sony offers some older titles on the PS5, but nowhere near the amount that Microsoft added to its Xbox catalogs. It came down to one decision, made years ago.
a.title: Why PlayStation can't hold a candle to Xbox's backward compatibility

b.lede: The PS5 can't play every disc that the PS3 and PS4 were compatible with, but most of what you'll want to play and watch is supported.
b.title: What discs can a PlayStation 5 play?
